physicalNotes: No radius or mass of M87 is recorded: it is an extended galaxy, and its package frames it at 199000 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: Charlot et al. (2020), A&A 644, A159: ICRF3, the position SIMBAD adopts for M 87. (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202038368); catalogue reference Charlot2020A&A...644A.159C
sources.distance: Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration (2019), ApJL 875, L1 (M87 Paper I), Table 1: D = 16.8 +/- 0.8 Mpc, rederived from likelihood distributions in Paper VI. (https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.11238); catalogue reference EHT2019ApJ...875L...1E: 16800000 pc (-800000/+800000); adopted
sources.properMotion: Zero: the galaxy is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
